predictions.selection_reason: assignment of element text property with user-controlled content -> direct DOM manipulation -> potential XSS if property is tainted
predictions.source_summary: Element text content from DOM elements selected by target parameter, which can be CSS selector string or element collection. Content originates from HTML markup or previous DOM manipulations.
predictions.sink_summary: DOM textContent/innerText property assignment, which can execute HTML/script if content contains unescaped markup
predictions.guard_summary: No input sanitization or escaping before assignment. The operation occurs in a conditional branch for previously-shaved elements, but no security controls validate or escape the text content.
predictions.risk_pattern: Direct assignment of potentially unsanitized DOM text content back to the same element's text property, which could execute script content if the original element contained HTML/script markup
enclosing_conditions: if (span) - executes when element has already been shaved and contains .js-shave span
predictions.context_summary: The assignment occurs when re-processing a previously truncated element. It removes the ellipsis character span and reassigns the element's text property to itself, potentially re-interpreting HTML content
unresolved_facts: Whether the original element content is trusted/controlled by the application or could contain attacker-controlled data
Whether the library is typically used with sanitized/trusted content only

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: DOM text property assignment with potentially unsanitized content leading to XSS

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
top_sast_rules.description: Reinterpreting text from the DOM as HTML can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Detect output operations that lack proper encoding for the target context
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use context-appropriate encoding for all output operations. Implement proper escaping for HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and URL contexts.
